topic.symptom: Two memory modules are installed side by side instead of in the slots the manual recommends.
topic.title: Using Two RAM Sticks? Check Which Slots

script: Using two RAM sticks? Unplug it before opening the case. Your manual lists which slots to use for two. On many boards, it's A2 and B2, not side by side. Your board's manual decides, not this example. Plug it back in. Then try booting again.

storyboard.title: Using Two RAM Sticks? Check Which Slots
storyboard.narrationStyle: Calm, conversational, one check. The captions are burned into the cut; no voice generated.

beats.visualDirection: Close on the board's four memory slots: two sticks in the first two, side by side.

beats.narration: Unplug it before opening the case.
beats.visualDirection: At the back of the power supply, the power cord comes out of the inlet.

beats.narration: Your manual lists which slots to use for two.
beats.visualDirection: Closer: the slots labelled A1 A2 B1 B2 (EXAMPLE LAYOUT); A2 and B2 glow amber.

beats.narration: On many boards, it's A2 and B2, not side by side.
beats.visualDirection: A red cross beside the side-by-side pair; both sticks lift and move to A2 and B2; a green tick.

beats.narration: Your board's manual decides, not this example.
beats.visualDirection: The sticks in A2 and B2; YOUR MANUAL DECIDES; EXAMPLE LAYOUT stays on screen.
At the back, the power cord goes back into the power supply.
The unlit PC beside the dark monitor, its power button pulsing amber. No one presses it; no boot is shown.

claims.proposition: unplug the power cable before working inside the PC
claims.basis: Crucial, "How to Install Memory in Your Desktop" (https://www.crucial.com/support/install-memory-desktop): "Shut down your system. Once your system has been powered off, unplug the power cable." Checked 2026-10-12 via search excerpts; the factual-takeaway gate re-reads it.

claims.proposition: the manual lists which slots to use for two modules; on many ASUS boards, A2 and B2
claims.basis: ASUS, "[Motherboard] How to install DRAM (Memory) on Motherboard? (FAQ 1047257)" (https://www.asus.com/support/faq/1047257/): "Search-excerpt wording: If two DRAMs, please install to DIMM_A2 and DIMM_B2 slots; the manual's "Recommended memory configuration" section lists the slots for one, two or four modules." Checked 2026-10-12 via search excerpts; the factual-takeaway gate re-reads it. Checked 2026-10-12 via search excerpts; the factual-takeaway gate re-reads it.

claims.proposition: not every board uses A2 and B2; the board's own manual decides
claims.basis: ASUS, "ROG RAMPAGE VI EXTREME OMEGA DRAM QVL (8 DIMM slots)" (https://dlcdnets.asus.com/pub/ASUS/mb/LGA2066/ROG_RAMPAGE_VI_EXTREME_OMEGA/ROG_RAMPAGE_VI_EXTREME_OMEGA_DRAM_QVL_V4.0.pdf): "Search-excerpt summary: this board uses different slots for two modules (B1 and D1)."
